elements.description:
The chunks retrieved for an answer – score, source and place, freshness, whether the answer used them – and the
misses the app reports.

properties.name: query
properties.description: The query the chunks were retrieved for

properties.name: chunks
properties.description: The chunks, in rank order – the first is the best match

properties.name: misses
properties.description: Chunks the app reports should have been retrieved and weren't

properties.name: cutoff
properties.description: The score below which chunks are left out of the prompt – marked on every score bar; unset marks none

properties.name: maxScore
properties.description: The top of the score scale – defaults to 1, or the highest score when that is higher

properties.name: show
properties.description: Which chunks show: "all", "used" (by the answer) or "unused"

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The id of the open chunk, or null

properties.name: profile
properties.description: How fast sources go stale, for chunks without their own `profile` – see tc-validity-badge

properties.name: now
properties.description: The moment freshness is counted to, in epoch ms – defaults to when each badge connected

properties.name: openHandled
properties.description: Open source fires tc-open-source and the link doesn't navigate on its own; chunks without a url get the button

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The list's height before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: formatScore
properties.description: Formats a score – defaults to two decimals, e.g. "0.82"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-show-change
events.description: All, Used or Not used was picked ({ show }: RetrievalShowChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: A chunk was picked or the open one closed ({ selected, chunk }: RetrievalSelectedChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-open-source
events.description: Open source was pressed, or Enter on a chunk with a source to open ({ chunk }: RetrievalOpenSource)

props.name: show
props.description: Which chunks show – "all", "used" or "unused". Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps it

props.name: defaultShow
props.description: Which chunks show at first when `show` isn't controlled

props.name: onShowChange
props.description: Called with the filter the user picked, controlled or not

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the open chunk, or null. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: The chunk open at first when `selected` isn't controlled

props.name: onSelectedChange
props.description: Called with the chunk picked (or null when it closes), controlled or not

props.name: onOpenSource
props.description: Called by Open source. With it the link doesn't navigate on its own – open the document yourself
